constraints.statement: The collected data must concern clinical trials of GLP-1 medications used for weight management.
Each collected trial record must include sample size, treatment duration, average weight change, adverse-event withdrawals, sponsor, and trial-registration link.

goals.statement: Collect clinical-trial data for GLP-1 medications used for weight management.

outcomes.description: A collection of clinical-trial records for GLP-1 medications used for weight management, containing the requested trial fields.

unknowns.question: Which GLP-1 medications and clinical trials satisfy the stated scope?
